title: How do I add useful links?
intent: This article explains how to add useful links that appear in the survey sidebar.
short_answer: Useful links are hyperlinks displayed on every page of the survey, typically in a sidebar alongside background documents. Add them through survey Properties.
procedure: Navigate to the Useful Links section.
Enter the link URL and display text.
The link appears on every survey page.
important_conditions: Useful links appear in the survey sidebar on every page.
Links open in a new window/tab.
Links are displayed alongside background documents.
Advanced useful links can also be configured.
troubleshooting: Link not appearing: Save properties and apply changes if published.
